structure: Recovery off the 1.83 low topped at the 2.54/2.56 double top and broke its neckline — the uptrend is damaged and price now hinges on the 2.13 pivot.
market_structure.volatility_note: The sharp drop off 2.56 has coiled into a tight 2.13–2.24 base — contracting, not expanding.
market_structure.bias_note: Two-sided at 2.13 — the higher-EV lean is long only if 2.13 holds; this is a level test, not a trend.

intermarket.note: NEAR is tracking BTC almost tick-for-tick (COR 15M +0.94) — both topped and sold off in the same window. With BTC now in a 4H downtrend near its lows (67.3k→63k), that tight correlation pressures NEAR: it favours the 2.13 break and works against the long until BTC stabilises.

pattern_candidates.name: Double Top
pattern_candidates.summary: The 2.54/2.56 double top broke its neckline and the measured move to ~2.12 is already complete — the reversal was right, but the move is largely spent; only a bounce to the neckline offers a fresh short.

stop.note: Reclaim of the post-break lower high negates the top

entry.tools: Measured move · broken neckline · PR levels

evidence: Two equal highs at 2.543 / 2.563, the second a marginal sweep that rejected — demand failed twice at the same level.
Neckline (~2.34) broke on the 2.44→2.31 4H candle, confirming the reversal.
Measured target (~2.12) already reached at 2.132 — the thesis has played out.
missing: Fresh downside — a new short here bets on extension below a target already met (lower probability).

warnings: Measured move already complete — limited room
Needs a bounce to the neckline to enter

pattern_candidates.name: Failed Breakdown / Double Bottom
pattern_candidates.summary: Price flushed the 2.13 measured-move target twice and is basing, not breaking — supply is exhausting at a triple-confluence level; needs a reclaim of 2.285 to confirm.

stop.note: Acceptance below the flush low kills the higher-low thesis

t1.note: PR Average — first pivot to bank into

t2.note: Broken neckline reclaim into pre-top supply

entry.tools: Predictive Ranges · 1H RSI divergence · horizontal S/R

evidence: Flushed to 2.132 twice and is basing — sellers can't get acceptance below the measured target.
1H RSI held ~49 while price retested the low — momentum no longer confirming downside (early bullish divergence).
The 2.10–2.15 shelf is prior resistance turned support — a structural floor.
missing: No confirmation yet — needs a reclaim and hold of 2.285 / 2.34 to prove demand.

warnings: BTC risk-off, COR +0.94 — correlation is a headwind

pattern_candidates.name: Bearish Breakdown
pattern_candidates.summary: If 2.13 gives way on a 4H close, the compression resolves down and the double-top reversal extends toward the next daily shelf — a scenario short, not yet live.

stop.note: Back inside the base = failed breakdown (flips to the long)

entry.tools: PR Lower-2 · daily higher-low · range S/R

evidence: A 4H close below 2.13 breaks the measured-move base and the compression resolves down.
BTC risk-off (COR +0.94) is pulling NEAR toward the break — correlation favours the downside.
missing: The break itself — nothing to do while 2.13 holds.

checks: PR Lower-2 (1.979) and the 1.92 daily HL define the downside
warnings: Limited room into a known support shelf
